The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No. 310 of 2023, under Sections 376 AB IPC and 5M/6 POCSO Act, Police Station- Raunahi District Ayodhya/Faizabad.

In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant had gone out of her home for relieving herself when the applicant, who was sitting there, took her by use of force and subsequently the girl was recovered at 06:00 AM in an unconscious state, afterwards she informed Surendra Maurya vs State Of U.P. sentences.text:
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 CrPC, the victim stated that she had gone out of her home at about 01:00 in the night,
when the applicant caught hold of her and committed rape upon her.

In her statement recorded under Section 164 CrPC she stated that she used to talk to the applicant, on the phone, for the last 2-3 months, she also stated that they used to talk for 2-3 hours in the night and that she had begun to like him, she further stated that on 01.07.2023, when she went out of her home the applicant forcibly took her and committed rape upon her and left her in unconscious state.
The medical on record, which was done after two days, does not corroborate the allegations leveled in the FIR.
The FSL report filed by the State also does not indicate that any opinion can be given from the samples collected from the victim and the applicant.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

Considering the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 CrPC, the medical report on record and the FSL report, there are gaps in the prosecution story, as such the applicant who is in custody since 03.07.2023 is entitled to be released on bail, particularly when the applicant has no criminal history.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
